sehemu: Part I: The Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and the President of Zanzibar
jina: Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and his authority
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar who shall be the President of Zanzibar, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and also the Chairman of the Revolutionary Council of Zanzibar. (2) Before assuming office, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall take before the Chief Justice of Zanzibar an oath to protect and defend the Constitution of the United Republic and any other oath prescribed by the Constitution of Zanzibar relating to the performance of his functions, and shall thereafter assume and exercise those powers in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984. (3) In addition to his other powers, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall appoint and assign responsibilities to Ministers and Deputy Ministers of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar.
vifungu: (1) There shall be a Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar who shall be the President of Zanzibar, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and also the Chairman of the Revolutionary Council of Zanzibar.

(2) Before assuming office, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall take before the Chief Justice of Zanzibar an oath to protect and defend the Constitution of the United Republic and any other oath prescribed by the Constitution of Zanzibar relating to the performance of his functions, and shall thereafter assume and exercise those powers in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984.

(3) In addition to his other powers, the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall appoint and assign responsibilities to Ministers and Deputy Ministers of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar.
